name: Kairos Power Hermes 2
notes: First deployment under the October 2024 Kairos Power-Google Master Plant Development Agreement (Google fleet-wide target of up to 500 MW across multiple Kairos plants by 2035). Power is delivered via a Tennessee Valley Authority PPA (announced 2025-08-18) -- the first US utility PPA for an advanced Gen IV reactor -- intended to serve Google data centers in Montgomery County, TN and Jackson County, AL (grid-region delivery, no single named campus). Shares the Heritage Center/ETTP campus with the earlier, smaller non-power-producing Hermes 1 demonstration reactor but sits on a distinct K-33 parcel. Target operation by 2030.

name: Cascade Advanced Energy Facility
source: Cascade Advanced Energy Facility pre-application project page
notes: Amazon announced funding (2024-10-16) for the feasibility/environmental/safety/permitting/licensing phase of four Xe-100 reactors with Energy Northwest and X-energy, amid AI-driven power demand. Energy Northwest owns, builds, and operates the facility; X-energy is the reactor-technology licensor. Amazon holds a contractual right to purchase power from the first 320 MW phase; public power utilities may purchase up to 50% of the full 960 MW build-out per Energy Northwest's own project page, so Amazon's offtake share of the full build-out is not necessarily 100%. Design-builder Cascade Nuclear Partners (Kiewit Nuclear Solutions / Black & Veatch / Aecon) selected 2025. Amazon separately anchored a ~$500M Series C-1 investment in X-energy (announced 2024-10-16, alongside Amazon's Climate Pledge Fund, Citadel's Ken Griffin, Ares Management affiliates, NGP, and the University of Michigan) supporting X-energy's reactor design/licensing and Phase 1 of its TRISO-X fuel fabrication facility in Oak Ridge, TN -- this is company-level X-energy funding, not Cascade project capex. Project-level construction jobs are projected at ~1,000-2,000 and operational jobs at ~100-200 per Energy Northwest's own project page; these are the operator's projections, not delivered/operational counts, and are recorded here as notes rather than in the jobs field.
